entry.title: AI IN THE MUSIC INDUSTRY: What Does It Mean for Artists?

media:group.media:title: AI IN THE MUSIC INDUSTRY: What Does It Mean for Artists?
media:group.media:description:
Join us for an insightful discussion featuring Daniel Rowland. With over 17 billion streams, Daniel is a music producer and tech executive at LANDR. His extensive career includes work with major entities like Pixar and Disney, and artists such as Nine Inch Nails, Eminem, and Nina Simone.
As a co-founder of Audiotool and educator, he has spent over a decade empowering creators with ethical Al tools, bridging the gap between high-level industry production and accessible technology.
About the Speakers:
• Daniel Rowland: Co-Founder of Audiotool, VP of Strategy & Partnership at LANDR.
• Drishay: 1/2 of Chicago-based DJ duo Syncrhonized Swimming
• Camille Hamel: Co-Founder of Purple Tea Records
This event waspart of Music Week à MTL and a series of conversations for beginner producers and artists and students trying to break into the EDM music scene with current experts in the field.
Organized by:
Husam Tannira Camille Hamel
With:
Tim Hortons Electrocon LANDR

entry.title: MORE THAN MUSIC: Building a Brand People Remember

media:group.media:title: MORE THAN MUSIC: Building a Brand People Remember
media:group.media:description:
Join us for a conversation on what it takes to build a career that extends beyond the music itself.
Featuring former Dim Mak President Lorne Padman, Turn Muzik VP of A&R Charles Lewis, and DJ & tastemaker/curator Grahm Radio, this session explores how artists can stand out in a crowded industry by building a memorable brand and meaningful relationships.
We'll discuss authentic networking, approaching labels and managers professionally, and turning connections into long-term opportunities.

entry.title: LABEL 101: Mastering the Art of Self-Releases in 2026

media:group.media:title: LABEL 101: Mastering the Art of Self-Releases in 2026
media:group.media:description:
Ready to take control of your music career? Join us for an essential masterclass featuring sharp industry minds, including A&Rs from Nervous Records, Phoenix Music, and Purple Tea Records, as we pull back the curtain on the independent release landscape.
Whether you're looking to master distribution, refine your marketing, or break into the charts, this panel is your roadmap. Learn how to think, act, and release like a pro. Hosted by Camille Hamel, step inside the minds of the A&Rs who shape the scene and discover actionable strategies to launch your music.
About the Speakers:
Mike Nervous Founder of Nervous Records
Andy Reid Founder of Phoenix Music
Camille Hamel Co-Founder of Purple Tea Records
Justin Rodrigue Co-Founder of Purple Tea Records

entry.title: PRODUCTION 101: Getting Started in the Studio

media:group.media:title: PRODUCTION 101: Getting Started in the Studio
media:group.media:description:
Join Purple Tea Records co-founder Camille Hamel as he reunites with his former mentor, the legendary D. Ramirez, Head Instructor at Toolroom Academy and Founder of Raven Studios, for an exclusive & unfiltered conversation moderated by Canadian House pioneer Andy Reid. entry.title: A Closer Look: The Solar Simulator

media:group.media:title: A Closer Look: The Solar Simulator
media:group.media:description:
Join us for the next installment of tour Closer Look series - exploring the many labs and spaces across Concordia University, giving you a closer look at what happens here!
This session takes us to the Solar Simulator & Environmental Chamber Lab where the team at the lab will show us what they are working on this summer! ☀️
The Solar Simulator reproduces natural sunlight, enabling accurate and repeatable testing of solar systems, focusing on the integration of solar energy systems into buildings to generate electricity, useful heat and daylighting.

entry.title: LANDR Studio: From DAW to Distribution

media:group.media:title: LANDR Studio: From DAW to Distribution
media:group.media:description:
Join us as Concordia's Electrocon & Music Week à Montréal come to 4th Space for a series of presentations, workshops, and conversations with experts in music production! 🎧
The final session of the day welcomes Anthony Albanese, Mike Salvione, and Camille Hamel for a conversation designed to show artists exactly how to leverage the full LANDR ecosystem for their next release.
From finding the perfect sample to global distribution, the panelists will walk through how these tools work together to elevate your creative workflow.

entry.title: Beyond Burnout: Sustaining Creativity and Performance in Electronic Music

media:group.media:title: Beyond Burnout: Sustaining Creativity and Performance in Electronic Music
media:group.media:description:
Join us as Concordia's Electrocon & Music Week à Montréal come to 4th Space for a series of presentations, workshops, and conversations with experts in music production! 🎧
The fourth session of the day welcomes Dr. Suni Lampasso, Lorne Padman, and Vito V for a deep dive into maintaining longevity in a high-pressure industry.
This session moves beyond surface-level advice to address the real challenges of creative blocks, self-doubt, and the mental demands of touring. Panelists will discuss practical strategies for managing industry expectations, avoiding comparison traps, and building a sustainable, fulfilling career.

entry.title: Beat the Clock: Finish More Professional-Sounding Tracks Faster with Mike Salvione

media:group.media:title: Beat the Clock: Finish More Professional-Sounding Tracks Faster with Mike Salvione
media:group.media:description:
Join us as Concordia's Electrocon & Music Week à Montréal come to 4th Space for a series of presentations, workshops, and conversations with experts in music production! 🎧
The third session of the day welcomes electronic music artist and entrepreneur Salvione for a beginner-to-intermediateworkshop guiding producers through a 9-step framework for turning ideas into release-ready tracks.
Rather than focusing on abstract theory, the session offers a practical, step-by-step roadmap for building professional music, helping attendees improve their workflow, increase their intention, and overcome common obstacles like getting stuck in loops.

entry.title: 10X YOUR CAREER: The Business Behind Being An Artist with Mike Salvione

media:group.media:title: 10X YOUR CAREER: The Business Behind Being An Artist with Mike Salvione
media:group.media:description:
Join us as Concordia's Electrocon & Music Week à Montréal come to 4th Space for a series of presentations, workshops, and conversations with experts in music production! 🎧
The second session of the day welcomes electronic music artists and entrepreneurs Salvione and Drishay of Synchronized Swimming, where they will show you how to 10x your artist career by treating it like the business it actually is.
Learn how to put real systems in place, the same ones companies use to grow, scale, and stay efficient, so one person really can do the job of a whole team. The result is more time, less overwhelm, and the freedom to get back to the reason you started in the first place: Music.

entry.title: Projected Futures X Volt-Age: Panel Discussion

media:group.media:title: Projected Futures X Volt-Age: Panel Discussion
media:group.media:description:
Join us for a panel discussion moderated by the Protected Futures coordinator, Cristina Sanza!
Projected Futures is an intensive and experiential summer school that challenges us to rethink how science is communicated with society. The course welcomes local and international graduate students from diverse educational backgrounds. Graduate students are exposed to the foundations of evidence-based science journalism and to experiment to create new forms of scientific storytelling.

entry.title: A Closer Look: Dylan Fraser Fish Lab Applied Science Hub, Aquatics

media:group.media:title: A Closer Look: Dylan Fraser Fish Lab Applied Science Hub, Aquatics
media:group.media:description:
Join us for the next installment of tour Closer Look series - exploring the many labs and spaces across Concordia University, giving you a closer look at what happens here!
This session takes us back to where it all began, the Dylan Fraser Fish Lab at the Applied Science Hub (Aquatics) at Loyola Campus where Dylan Fraser and the team at the lab will show us what they are working on this summer!
The Fraser Lab integrates ecology, evolution, and genetics/genomics towards conservation and management of natural populations, species, and ecosystem, with a focus on fish.

media:group.media:title: Alan Shepard Residency Vernissage
media:group.media:description:
10 Years of Transformation
The Alan Shepard Residency is District 3's flagship 12-week paid experience for Concordia students, placing multidisciplinary teams directly with real Montreal organizations to solve real challenges, not case studies. Engineers sit beside filmmakers, economists beside musicians, learning to speak each other's language while tackling mandates that demand real, tangible results.
Celebrating its 10th anniversary, this year’s edition embraces the theme “10 × 10 = 100: Journeys of …Transformation”, highlighting a decade of student-led innovation and the many paths through which ideas evolve into meaningful impact.
This year’s vernissage offers an opportunity to discover the projects developed by the 2026 cohort, meet the student residents, and explore how experiential learning continues to shape the next generation of innovators at Concordia.
